t: Knowing Your Identity Under The Order Of Melchizedek.
s: This church service message teaches that Christians hold royal citizenship and legal rights under the Order of Melchizedek rather than living with a slave mentality. By understanding this covenant contract, believers operate as spiritual legislators, protect their families from spiritual attacks, and honor God through communion and tithing.
r: Genesis 14:18-20 · Genesis 15:1 · Psalm 23
pts: Moses wrote Genesis to give former slaves a true lineage and kingdom identity so they would not fall back into an Egyptian bondage mindset.
Abraham was called a Hebrew (meaning 'one that crossed over') because God removed him from his natural country to make him an entirely new nation.
Emergencies and conflicts often serve as wake-up calls to force believers to recognize and use their spiritual authority.
In Genesis 14, Melchizedek met an exhausted Abraham with bread, wine, and a blessing, bringing him into God's economic household system.
The King of Sodom sought to claim souls while offering goods, whereas Melchizedek offered spiritual covenant without demanding souls.
Tithing under the Order of Melchizedek is not a religious transaction, but an acknowledgment of God as the true King and ruler over one's household.
Covenant rights function like constitutional citizenship rights; believers must know their legal rights to petition God's throne and exercise authority.
Psalm 23's 'table in the presence of my enemies' is fulfilled through the bread and wine of communion, providing nourishment and ratifying covenant strength.
Parents and leaders have a spiritual responsibility to guard their homes and children against spiritual attacks and evil generational altars.
qs: Church as usual is done.
Where did you come from? Because if you don't know where you come from, you don't know where you going.
If you don't know what you have, you won't know how to use it.
chk: The speaker claims that anyone appointed as a watchman over the youth in their ministry will die if they are out of alignment with God.

t: Christianity Was Never Supposed to Become This | Dr. Francis Myles
s: Dr. Francis Myles argues that modern institutional Christianity is a fragmented, weakened version of the original faith due to historical divisions and Roman cultural labeling. He contends that believers must transition into the 'Order of Melchizedek' and function as a governmental body with kingdom authority rather than a divided religious institution.
r: Acts 11:26 · Matthew 12:24-28 · Luke 11:17 · Matthew 16:13-19 · Genesis 1:26-28 · Genesis 2:19 · Isaiah 66:8
pts: Reformation requires dismantling inaccurate religious patterns and traditions inherited from previous generations.
Institutional Christianity has become an obstacle to the kingdom of God because it creates sectarian subcultures that divide believers.
Religious systems thrive on division, whereas the kingdom of God functions as a sovereign government requiring unity.
Jesus did not come to establish a religion; he came to restore a heavenly government on earth.
Believers cannot build the church accurately or understand their own authority without an accurate revelation of Jesus' identity.
The term 'church' comes from the Greek word 'ecclesia', which refers to a governing senate rather than a religious social organization.
The name 'Christian' was not assigned by Jesus or the apostles, but by Roman onlookers in Antioch as a derogatory term meaning 'little Christ'.
Paul never used the term 'Christian' in his epistles, instead addressing believers as saints and kingdom citizens.

Naming carries spiritual authority according to five principles: (1) whoever names a thing retains power over it, (2) names reflect nature, (3) names create distinction from generality, (4) names dictate function, and (5) names determine destiny.
The Order of Melchizedek is presented as an ancient royal priesthood predating both Judaism and Christianity, bridging back to Abraham's covenant with God.
qs: Because Jesus did not come on earth to restore a religion. He came to restore a government.
Whosoever names a thing retains power over what they name.
You can never build the church accurately if you don't see Jesus accurately.
chk: The name 'Christian' was historically invented in Antioch purely as a mocking insult meaning 'little Christ'.
Zimbabwe is prophesied to experience massive financial wealth and become the breadbasket of Africa again, drawing visiting heads of state to study its economic turnaround.

t: You’re Not a Victim—God Is Positioning You for Influence | Dr. Francis Myles
s: Dr. Francis Myles reinterprets the Book of Daniel as a clash of kingdoms rather than end-times doom, showing how believers are positioned inside hostile systems to gain influence. He argues that the Gospel of the Kingdom provides the core message (the wine), while the Melchizedek priesthood provides the operating structure (the wineskin) that empowers believers to function as both priests and kings.
r: Daniel 2:31-35 · Daniel 2:46 · Revelation 6
pts: You are never a victim of circumstances when walking in God's will; difficult placements (like Daniel in Babylon) are divine deployments.
Faith and kingdom power require a 'culture of contrast' (resistance and foreign systems) to be tested and proven effective.
The Book of Daniel is a master manual for the Gospel of the Kingdom demonstrating prototype victories before the cross.
In Daniel 1, the clash was over diet and bodily mastery, proving that kingdom-aligned discipline yields tenfold superior intellect and scientific understanding.
In Daniel 2, God deliberately erased Nebuchadnezzar's dream from memory to expose the limits of worldly magicians and set the stage for Daniel.
Complex national and marketplace problems cannot be solved alone; they require a 'mastermind' of aligned kingdom thinkers praying together.

The golden statue represents the decaying progression of human empires (gold down to iron and clay), while the supernatural stone cut without human hands is Jesus and His expanding kingdom that outlasts and displaces all worldly systems.
The Gospel of the Kingdom is the 'wine' (the message and raw power), while the order of Melchizedek is the 'wineskin' or 'bottle' that makes the message structured and marketable.
The Melchizedek alignment integrates the priest (spiritual intimacy, prayer) and the king (commercial ability, governance, wealth creation) into one person.
qs: when you are walking in the will of God, you are never a victim of circumstances.
the book of Daniel is about the clash of kingdoms.
The order of makes the kingdom message marketable.
chk: The four Hebrew boys became ten times wiser in aerodynamics, physics, and science after a 10-day kingdom diet.
Y2K-era apocalyptic Christian authors made millions selling gasoline and doomsday supplies on a crisis that never occurred.

t: Why Your Life Keeps Returning to Chaos | Dr. Francis Myles
s: An explanation of the Melchizedek priesthood as God's eternal framework for defeating spiritual immaturity, establishing divine order, and breaking the internal cycle of addiction to chaos.
r: 2 Corinthians 5:16 · 2 Corinthians 5:17 · Psalm 110:1-4 · Hebrews 5 · Exodus 19 · Genesis 14
pts: Believers are called not to know Christ after the flesh, because seeing Jesus through divine identity rather than human exterior is the key to breaking prejudice and uniting all nations in the church.
God's oath in Psalm 110:4 establishes the Melchizedek priesthood as an immutable, eternal order that Christ entered and that believers inherit.
The deeper mysteries of the Melchizedek order remain veiled to believers who remain on spiritual milk and self-centeredness ('me, myself, and I'), requiring spiritual maturity to receive.
God wraps deep truths in divine mystery to confuse demonic powers—just as principalities would not have crucified Christ had they known the mystery—and to hide pearls from the unprepared.
Israel was originally offered the Melchizedek priesthood of kings and priests at Sinai (Exodus 19), but because they retreated into carnal fear, God permitted the temporary Levitical priesthood.
Moses entered the Melchizedek order while beholding God's glory on Mount Sinai, enabling him to supernaturally record the history of Genesis from Adam through Joseph in 40 days.

David functioned under Melchizedek grace rather than Levitical restrictions, allowing him to sleep beside the Ark of the Covenant, house it safely in Zion for 41 years, and eat the sacred showbread without facing death.
The 41 years the Ark spent in David's tent parallels the 41 generations from Adam to Christ, symbolizing the reconciliation of God's presence with humanity.
Applying the concept of entropy/chaos theory, he argues that all natural systems drift into chaos unless intercepted by an invisible ordering force, which divine order provides.
The Melchizedek priesthood integrates kingly marketplace governance with temple priestly ministry, founded entirely on Christ's righteousness rather than human performance.
True biblical shalom means not only 'nothing missing, nothing broken,' but being delivered from the internal psychological and spiritual principle that addicts individuals and leaders to chaos.
qs: My message removes self from the throne of of human life and puts Jesus there.
The purpose of order is to reveal the one behind the order.
Shalom also means to be delivered from the principle that addicts you to chaos.
chk: That the Ark of the Covenant remained in David's tent in Jerusalem for precisely 41 years.
That biblical genealogy tracks exactly 41 generations from Adam to Jesus Christ.
The assertion that physics defines a 'law of chaos' stating every particle moves toward chaos unless intercepted by an order (referencing entropy/the Second Law of Thermodynamics).
for: Believers struggling with recurring disorder, self-centered spiritual stagnation, or confusion regarding the biblical transition from the Levitical system to the Melchizedek priesthood.

t: The Hidden Spiritual Battle Behind Your Success | Dr. Francis Myles
s: Dr. Francis Myles argues that society is shaped by seven cultural mountains guarded by powerful fallen angels who overpower mere human talent and personal anointing. To survive the corruption zone where successful people crash, believers must invoke the legal authority of the Order of Melchizedek rather than fighting in their own strength.
r: Revelation 11:15 · Revelation 17 · 1 Samuel 21:8 · Proverbs 22:9 · Daniel 7 · 1 Samuel 30 · Hebrews 5 · Hebrews 6 · Hebrews 7 · Genesis 1
pts: Myles identifies seven cultural spheres: Law and Government, Finance, Media/Arts/Entertainment, Education, Business, Family, and Church.
He calls them the seven mountains of Babylon because they currently operate under a demonic system characterized by moral mixture and compromise.
The mountain of Law and Government is the regulatory mountain that sets policies governing the other six spheres.
The mountain of Business is the largest employer and exists primarily to generate profit; Myles claims God does not trust unprofitable enterprises.
He rejects escapist rapture theology, arguing the Tower of Babel represents a mindset that prioritizes leaving for heaven over discipling earth.
Low-level demons test believers early on, but higher levels of cultural influence are guarded by high-ranking fallen angels.
The corruption zone is the gap between an individual's personal anointing and the greater spiritual stature of a fallen angel guarding a mountain.
In the corruption zone, leaders often suffer sudden moral failure, financial ruin, or betrayal by trusted staff.
David survived Ziklag (1 Samuel 30) by putting on the high priest's linen ephod and inquiring of God rather than relying on military might.
Believers must use spiritual invocation like a police officer using a radio: call upon the higher legal authority of the Melchizedek priesthood when outgunned.
qs: The seven heads are the seven mountains.
The primary object of the mantra of business is the creation of profit.
Because when you are diligent in your craft, it's inevitable you're going to meet the kings of industries.
chk: Claims that 60% of Christian children entering Arizona State University graduate as agnostics or atheists.
Asserts that high-ranking fallen angels hold territorial custody over specific cultural institutions.
Claims a $4.5 million lawsuit against a church in Hawaii was dismissed after the congregation prayed a specific Melchizedek warfare prayer.

t: Why Your Tithing May Not Be Working | Dr. Francis Myles
s: A theological framework transitioning your giving from the Old Covenant Levitical/Malachi model to the Melchizedek order, framed as an act of total surrender that activates divine interception and grants access to heaven's trading floor.
r: Isaiah 51:1-3 · Hebrews 7:4-10 · Malachi 1:6-7 · Malachi 2:1-2 · Malachi 3:8-10 · Genesis 14:17-20 · Hebrews 8
pts: Myles explains that his study of the Order of Melchizedek began after a 65-year-old faithful widow in Zambia asked why decades of consistent tithing had failed to open the 'windows of heaven' in her finances.
He teaches that Scripture contains two distinct tithing systems: the inferior Levitical tithe under the Law of Moses and the superior Melchizedek tithe initiated by Abraham through faith.

He argues that the book of Malachi was addressed specifically to Levitical priests who were robbing God by withholding the 'tithe of the tithe' from the high-priestly line of Aaron, making Malachi 3 an improper foundation for New Covenant tithing.

He asserts that the 'windows of heaven' in Malachi represent an Old Covenant provision designed for people without direct kingdom access, whereas New Covenant believers have access to 'doors' of blessing through Jesus.
He highlights Hebrews 7 to show that while mortal men collected tithes under the Levitical system, Jesus Himself receives tithes in the heavenly realm under the Melchizedek priesthood.

He defines tithing as the 'technology of Zion' and an outward manifestation of an inward spiritual surrender, comparing the giving of a tithe to Abraham lifting his hands in surrender to God Most High.
Using the story of Moses holding up his hands during the battle against the Amalekites, he argues that spiritual surrender—not business acumen or natural skill—determines marketplace victory.
He explains that Abraham tithed to Melchizedek on a trading floor in Genesis 14, framing the tithe as a licensing fee that opens access to a righteous heavenly trading platform.

He distinguishes between 'divine intervention' (rescue that occurs after damage has been sustained) and 'divine interception' (supernatural prevention of demonic attacks with zero losses), claiming Melchizedek tithing activates interception.
He advises believers whose local pastors teach the Malachi model not to argue with them, but to write 'Order of Melchizedek' in their check memos to align their giving spiritually.
qs: Who needs windows when the door has arrived?
tithing is an outward manifestation of an inward surrender.
chk: He claims that teaching the Melchizedek tithing model in American churches consistently increases congregational tithes by 40% to 50% without adding new members.
He asserts that the word 'Zion' does not exist in the syntax of human language and was introduced strictly via heavenly revelation to King David.
for: Christians and marketplace believers who practice tithing but feel frustrated by a lack of financial breakthrough under traditional Malachi-based stewardship teachings.

t: You Can Serve God and Still Miss Your Destiny | Dr. Francis Myles
s: Dr. Francis Myles teaches that a believer's true destiny is to be conformed into the image of Jesus, whereas outward ministry and career are merely temporary assignments. He argues that spiritual authority under the Order of Melchizedek must be exercised in the secular marketplace, using tithing as a spiritual mechanism to cleanse money and protect future generations.
r: Psalm 68:9 · Hebrews 5:1-6 · Psalms 110:4 · Hebrews 7:1-4 · Luke 7:31-32 · Genesis 14 · Psalm 67
pts: External spiritual work is not destiny: Myles argues that prophesying, casting out demons, and running church programs are temporary tasks, while the sole eternal destiny is conforming to the image of Christ.
Destiny vs. work confusion: Believers often win the battle of ministry reputation while losing the war of personal conformity to Jesus.
The Order of Melchizedek: The church vision is anchored in the Melchizedek priesthood (Hebrews 5 and 7), presenting Jesus as eternal High Priest.
Marketplace focus: Melchizedek met Abraham in the marketplace during conflict; true spiritual warfare and authority must function in business, jobs, and commerce, not just church halls.
Apostolic discipleship over comfort: Churches must teach mature spiritual 'meat' rather than appeasing emotional sensitivities and consumer-driven church culture.
Jesus chose marketplace candidates: Jesus did not select Temple Levites who only knew religious walls; He chose fishermen and tax collectors who worked in the commercial realm.

Tithing cleanses currency: Myles claims currency picks up spiritual contamination (such as lust, greed, and addiction) as it moves through society, and tithing acts as a priestly mechanism to spiritually clean it.
Tithing protects bloodlines: Abraham's tithe to Melchizedek spiritually secured Levi's future priesthood generations before Levi was born.
qs: The main point of speaking to the earth is not to give you a house. It is to remove obstacles that are stopping you from becoming like the sun.
Destiny is your person. The work is what he gives you to do while he's working while he's doing a face makeup.
Only a man who really has money realizes the problem of money.
chk: Claim that physical rain supernaturally follows the speaker when he travels to confirm Psalm 68:9.
Claim that physical currency carries transferred demonic spirits of lust and addiction from previous handlers unless spiritually cleansed by tithing.
Claim that Abraham's tithe spiritually pre-paid and locked Levi into the priesthood 400 years in advance.

t: God Is About to Move Everything Out of Your Way | Dr. Francis Myles
s: Dr. Francis Myles teaches that God moves obstacles out of the way when believers align with a clear heavenly vision rather than relying on endless church activity. Operating under the Melchizedek priesthood positions believers to function as kings in the marketplace and experience sudden divine interventions.
r: Proverbs 29:18 · Genesis 14:18-23 · Genesis 18
pts: A church and an individual's life cannot be sustained by busy activity alone; constant activity often masks an absence of vision.
Biblical vision is not human ambition or psychological imagination, but a divine disclosure that reorders life under God's eternal purpose (Proverbs 29:18).
Discipline and destiny are born out of vision, because knowing the purpose makes obedience intentional.
Every believer has a dual identity: a priest before God and a king in the marketplace.
The ministry's core vision is defined as being a church under the order of Melchizedek where every gathering is a festival with Jesus.
The biblical principle of first mention in hermeneutics establishes the Melchizedek priesthood in Genesis 14 when Abraham defeated five armies with 318 men.
Melchizedek appeared suddenly to protect Abraham from compromising with the King of Sodom.
A signature trait of the Melchizedek order is the spiritual mechanism of divine 'suddenlies'—rapid turnarounds that break long-standing bondages and debts.
When a vision originates from God, God assumes responsibility for clearing the obstacles out of the way so long as leadership remains obedient to it.
qs: Where there is no vision, the people perish.
The life of a church is not sustained by activity alone
Suddenly is a technology of the spirit.
chk: Claims that a friend's studio equipment in Texas repeatedly fried solely because of the spiritual energy Dr. Myles carried.
Claims God spoke directly to him saying that 'suddenly' is a spiritual technology He devised rather than merely an English word.

t: Why Melchizedek Appeared in the Marketplace—Not the Temple | Dr. Francis Myles
s: Dr. Francis Myles teaches that Melchizedek met Abraham on the battlefield rather than in a temple because spiritual warfare and kingdom ministry belong in the everyday marketplace. He argues that taking communion and tithing under the Melchizedek order secures divine blessing, marketplace authority, and the full recovery of lost resources.
r: Luke 7:31-32 · Genesis 14:11-24 · Hebrews 7:3
pts: Jesus described the people of this generation as children sitting in the marketplace (Luke 7:31-32), meaning the secular marketplace is the actual harvest field for ministry rather than the four walls of a church building.
A secular job or business is spiritual 'cover' (comparable to intelligence operatives) for believers to carry Holy Spirit power and reach people in distress.
Believers do not need full human qualification before God calls them; God qualifies and makes them effective as they submit.
The world is spiritually dangerous and uninformed about eternal realities, making everyday believers essential conduits for prophetic words and personal testimonies.
In Genesis 14, Melchizedek appeared to Abraham on the battlefield after a military victory, demonstrating that this priesthood operates directly in areas of territory, trade, and marketplace warfare.
The speaker argues that Melchizedek was a pre-incarnate appearance of Jesus Christ, referencing Hebrews 7 which describes him as without father, mother, beginning of days, or end of life.
Melchizedek brought bread and wine (communion) directly to the battlefield to spiritually strengthen Abraham rather than sending an army of angels.
Abraham tithed a tenth of everything to Melchizedek as a covenant ratification ('accepting the deal') that God Most High owns heaven and earth.
Abraham refused to take even a sandal strap from the King of Sodom so that no worldly system could claim credit for making him wealthy.
Entering the Melchizedek order is presented as a spiritual mechanism to recover goods, finances, and family relationships stolen by demonic warfare.
qs: The people of this generation are not inside the four walls of a church.
So, the marketplace is the harvest field.
He brought bread and wine to the battlefield.
Tithing is not to pay the bills of the church.
chk: Dr. Myles claims an audible voice spoke to his Catholic father three times, which led his father to seek him out and convert.
He claims that operating in the Melchizedek order guarantees supernatural favor where buyers will instinctively close deals with you.
He claims that spiritual communion directly disarms witchcraft and spiritual conspiracies targeted against one's marketplace career.

t: Why Your Money Keeps Leaving You No Matter How Much You Make | Dr. Francis Myles
s: A spiritual framework explaining how all worldly currency carries a residue of 'blood money,' and how tithing under the Melchizedek priesthood and taking communion cleanse personal finances from that demonic contamination.
r: Luke 6:12-16 · John 12:3-8 · Acts 1:15-20 · Genesis 4:7 · Matthew 27:1-6 · Matthew 15:8-9 · Hebrews 12 · Zechariah 11:12-13
pts: Dr. Francis Myles defines blood money as a spiritual leviathan and an economic system originating from the murder of Abel, asserting that every earthly currency carries a spiritual stain of blood.
He points to the Hebrew linguistic connection where the word for blood is 'dam' and money is 'damim,' arguing that rabbinical teaching links money to the expending of human blood, sweat, and labor.
Blood money is accumulated through four main avenues: injustice, deceit (such as scams), exploitation of human labor (such as unpaid or underpaid wages), and physical violence.
Judas Iscariot was not an outsider but a chosen apostle whose downfall began when he allowed the greed and spiritual pollution of the money box to corrupt his heart.

Judas's protest against Mary anointing Jesus with costly spikenard revealed that his desire for money had superseded his devotion to Jesus, demonstrating how the spirit of blood money blinds believers.
Judas's final act of throwing 30 pieces of silver into the temple was driven by Satan to flood the temple treasury with defiled blood money.
The chief priests recognized that the 30 pieces of silver were 'the price of blood' and could not lawfully be mixed into the sacred temple treasury without defiling it.
Zechariah accurately prophesied centuries in advance that the Messiah would be valued at 30 pieces of silver and that the money would be thrown into the house of the Lord for the potter.
Money absorbs the spiritual and moral climate in which it is generated (including witchcraft and violence), transferring that spiritual residue into the homes of believers who handle it.
Tithing is not merely church bill-paying, but a Melchizedek priestly mechanism designed to surrender money to God, cleansing the remaining ninety percent from the blood money system.
Believers cannot plead the blood of Jesus over finances they refuse to surrender to God through the tithe, and holy communion acts alongside the tithe as an antidote to financial curse.
qs: Satan cannot capture you with what you have already surrendered to God.
blood money is wealth that is stained by violence, oppression, betrayal, or human exploitation.
When you give a seed, you are giving for increase. When you give a tithe, you are giving for cleansing and surrender.
chk: He claims that the Hebrew word for blood is 'dam' and the Hebrew word for money is 'damim' because rabbis taught that no money could be earned without expending human blood.
He states that statistically only about 20% of the body of Christ tithes, leaving 80% operating in blood money.
for: Believers experiencing unexplained financial loss or leakage who want to break generational and systemic curses over their money through tithing and prayer.

t: Before God Gives You Wealth, He Must Build Your Priesthood | Dr. Francis Myles
s: Dr. Francis Myles argues that marketplace wealth carries spiritual defilement from the 'blood money system' that will crush an unprepared believer. He teaches that establishing personal priesthood through communion and tithing to the Melchizedek order is God's required spiritual buffer before receiving major financial increase.
r: Matthew 27:1-6 · Acts 1:16-20 · Genesis 14:18-20 · Malachi 3 · Micah 6:8 · Daniel 7:9-10 · James 5:4 · Hebrews 7:7 · Colossians 2:14 · Luke 16:13
pts: The marketplace is more spiritually dangerous than a physical battlefield because commercial greed drives world conflicts and economic wealth can corrupt the soul.
Abraham was intercepted by Melchizedek with bread and wine after the war of the nine kings specifically to prevent him from being captured by the blood-stained wealth of Sodom.
God intervenes in financial vulnerability through a priest rather than armies or angels because marketplace spiritual problems must be resolved through priesthood.
Priesthood is God's original and highest gift to humanity, which Adam practiced in Eden prior to the fall.
Money carries spiritual weight that produces pressure; without a strong daily priesthood, individuals often collapse into moral failure or addictions to find relief.
Communion protects the soul's mind, will, and emotions against the corrupting pride and self-worship that accompany higher levels of power.
Tithing under the Melchizedek order redeems currency from the historical 'blood money' system (stemming from Abel to Judas) and places it under heavenly legal jurisdiction.
Tithing is not a requirement for salvation, but a legal spiritual mechanism to insulate wealth and preserve the spiritual lineage of future generations.
A believer cannot be enslaved or spiritually captured by financial resources they have already surrendered to God.
Operating in the Courts of Heaven allows believers to formally renounce agreements with Mammon and seek legal cleansing from economic blood guilt.

you cannot be captured by what you have already surrendered to God.
Communion protects my soul.
Tithing protects my wealth.

t: Take down Leviathan - The Rise of a new Priesthood || Apostle Isi Igenegba
s: A strategic call for the church to move beyond mere religious encounters and dismantle the territorial Leviathan spirit over nations through systemic reformation and four distinct archetypes of deliverance.
r: Genesis 1:26-28 · Genesis 3 · Isaiah 27:1
pts: A 12-year-old prophetic dream revealed that political power handovers and violence in Nigeria are spiritually tied to an overarching territorial Leviathan serpent fueled by blood covenants and sacrifice.
The serpentine spirit is the primary spiritual system designed by darkness to challenge and undermine humanity's Genesis dominion mandate over geographical territory.

The Leviathan spirit operates primarily through deceptive, subtly corrupted conversations that sound like scripture and church doctrine, paralyzing believers into broken theology and passive dominion.

Waters are living spiritual domains, and territorial marine systems like Leviathan govern national economics, culture, and trade through coastal regions while demanding the sacrifice of blood and the stifling of future generations.

National transformation requires four archetypes to prepare the way for deliverance: Midwives (who fear God more than political regimes and refuse to abort the future), Jochebeds (who have generational audacity to build survival structures in hostile waters), Miriams (who run at the speed of the cultural current and track national shifts), and Pharaoh's daughters (secular actors moved by God to enact righteous policies).

Believers must not define their ultimate mission by the 'burning bush' of spiritual encounters or ministerial gifts, but must use those encounters as divine intelligence to govern and transform societal systems.

Every priest and leader must throw down their rod at Mount Horeb to confront and purge the internal serpentine lies that limit kingdom authority strictly to church walls rather than national rulership.
qs: Human strength cannot conquer what only God can subdue. National transformation requires divine intervention.
Conversation at the doors to realms. Whatever realm is conversation has come from is going to be the very realm that the hearer will be pulled into.
If you are going to be a true nation builder, you cannot reduce the responsibility of building an entire nation to only pull pits, gates and doors of churches.

t: Why Every Christian Needs the Order of Melchizedek | Dr. Francis Myles
s: Dr. Francis Myles argues that Christians are assigned secular jobs as covert marketplace ministers rather than mere bill-payers. He teaches that tapping into the Order of Melchizedek through communion and tithing activates supernatural authority to recover stolen goods and thrive in workplace spiritual warfare.

A secular job serves as spiritual 'cover' for believers to function as undercover agents for God's kingdom.
Believers are called to be prophetic people who listen for God's voice in the workplace to help colleagues facing unseen crises.
God operates a 'technology of deliverance' where He causes one person in a family to escape into faith so they can bring deliverance to the rest of the household.

s: Every believer is invited into an end-times Melchizedek priesthood of sonship to govern from heavenly thrones and exercise spiritual dominion over creation against the encroaching beast kingdom.
r: Genesis 14:18-20 · Genesis 1:26-28 · Genesis 2:15 · Luke 3:38 · Genesis 5:22 · Exodus 7:10-12 · Exodus 7:20-22 · Exodus 8:16-18 · Exodus 9:8-11 · Luke 1:5, 15 · Matthew 4:2-3, 8-10 · Revelation 11:3-7 · 1 Kings 1:5-9, 32-39 · Daniel 11:21, 32-35 · Revelation 13:1-5, 11-14 · Galatians 4:1-2
pts: The Melchizedek priesthood did not begin with the historical king of Salem; it represents a continuous heavenly order of sonship and dominion over creation that started with Adam and continued through Enoch, Noah, and Shem.

The speaker points to a 2011 archaeological discovery in the City of David—dubbed 'Temple Zero' near the Gihon Spring—asserting it is Melchizedek's ancient temple featuring an early Holy of Holies stone, altar blood channels, and olive and grape presses for bread and wine.

Adam's original assignment in the Garden of Eden used priestly Hebrew terms: 'abad' (to serve with priestly service) and 'shamar' (to guard, celebrate Sabbaths, and keep vows), establishing creation stewardship as a priestly function.

The Exodus plagues represented a direct showdown between competing priesthoods: Egyptian magicians replicated miracles in water and serpents via demonic covenants, but were stopped when God commanded dust and soot, proving darkness has limited dominion over the elements.

Jesus officially received the Melchizedek high priesthood at His baptism in the Jordan River, which fulfilled rabbinical high-priestly induction requirements: ceremonial washing, verbal attestation of lineage from the Father, and anointing by the Holy Spirit.

In the wilderness, Satan tempted Jesus to validate His sonship by misusing priestly dominion: manipulating creation for personal appetite, abusing angelic assistance for self-preservation (witchcraft), and trading heavenly allegiance for earthly kingdoms.

The Old Testament conflict between David's sons mirrors end-times division: Adonijah set up an altar at the Serpent's Stone (En-rogel/Dragon's Well) backed by priest Abiathar, while Solomon was taken to Gihon and anointed by Zadok using oil from Melchizedek's temple.

Scripture demonstrates a pattern where a Melchizedek forerunner always appears prior to a major manifestation or covenant of God, as seen with Melchizedek before Abraham's covenant, Jethro before Mount Sinai, and Jesus prior to His resurrection.

The book of Revelation details an end-times clash where the two witnesses and the saints battle through creation, but during the final 42 months the false prophet aligns corrupted creation with the beast kingdom through counterfeit signs and wonders.

The kingdom of darkness prevails primarily as 'squatters' who take ground where believers fail to occupy their spiritual seats, but maturing sons who take their thrones in the heavenly realms can overturn dark strongholds.
qs: Before the appearing of God, you will always see a Melkisedc priest as a forerunner to the appearance of God.
This was an altar to the serpent. And it says it's be beside in regel.
The the kingdom of darkness primarily wins because they are squatters.
This is not a priesthood that requires a special gifting, calling or anointing. Every single believer is called to this priesthood.
chk: That in 2011 archaeologists in the City of David discovered a structure dubbed 'Temple Zero' and concluded it was the temple of Melchizedek.
That ancient rabbinic tradition required three specific markers—ceremonial washing, a father's public attestation of sonship, and anointing with oil—to induct a high priest.
for: Believers seeking an eschatological framework that connects identity in sonship, the Melchizedek order, and spiritual authority over physical and spiritual creation.

t: How Hidden Altars Control Wealth In The Marketplace
s: Francis Myles argues that trade is a spiritual technology and every marketplace transaction is sponsored either by a righteous altar or an evil one. He contends that believers must operate under the order of Melchizedek and cultivate spiritual discernment to avoid bad investments and corrupted wealth.
r: Luke 7:31-32 · Genesis 14:11-23 · Acts 19:24-28 · Genesis 13 · Deuteronomy 11:11
pts: Trade is not just an earthly activity; the speaker teaches that trade is a spiritual technology invented by God.
Lucifer's fall involved unrighteous trading in the realm of glory, attempting to hold God's light for himself instead of reflecting it back.
Every marketplace trade is sponsored by a spiritual altar, and the sponsoring altar claims royalties over the transaction.
Demonic altars in the marketplace do not mind Christians becoming wealthy as long as the demonic altar is the entity sponsoring that wealth.
The King of Sodom offered to make Abraham wealthy, but Abraham refused so that no evil altar could claim credit for his prosperity.
In Acts 19, the silversmith Demetrius fought against the apostolic message because the idol-making trade of the goddess Diana supported an entire commercial industry.
Opposition in the marketplace often comes from people and systems profiting from evil trades rather than directly from spiritual entities.
The Melchizedek priesthood appeared to Abraham in the marketplace before the King of Sodom arrived, establishing an alternative, righteous economic system.
Tithing is framed by the speaker as a marketplace transaction and pledge of allegiance that activates spiritual protection against unrighteous trades.
The 'altar of Cain' manifests today when professionals destroy rivals, spread false reports, or sabotage others to dominate an industry.
The 'altar of Lot' represents grasping for profitable markets and quick returns while ignoring ethical red flags and moral compromise.
Spiritual discernment is necessary in business to detect corrupt spirits behind attractive paperwork and seemingly profitable partnerships.
qs: The whole ecosystem of the glory is based on the technology of trade.
If Satan cannot deceive you on the front end, he will steal on the back end.
Abraham was given the promise that was given to Abraham is to inherit the world.
The reason why we struggle with tithing because we are trying to teach church people, we are trying to teach, we're trying to teach church people tithing when tithing began with marketplace people.
chk: Pastors in Africa and elsewhere are hiring hitmen or consulting witch doctors to assassinate leaders of larger neighbouring churches.
Former NFL player 'Chi Bops' (likely referring to a player) made over $150 million and is going to jail over a $2,500 mafia-linked transaction.

t: God is Seeking A Nation of Kings and Priests
s: Christian DeVall argues that God is raising a nation of kings and priests rather than passive consumers who trade their divine innovation to worldly systems. True spiritual authority and alignment cannot come from borrowed faith or church consensus, but only through personal, vulnerable intimacy with God in the secret place.
r: Genesis 12:3-8 · Genesis 37 · Exodus 14:31 · John 2:11 · Acts 8:13 · Isaiah 28:18 · Acts 5:9 · Amos 3:3 · Exodus 21:8 · Exodus 25:1-9 · Exodus 25:22 · Daniel 11:31-32 · Matthew 26:26-28
pts: Apostolic ministry is meant to establish the government of God to build a nation of kings and priests, not maintain church attendance.
Joseph's prophetic insights and economic innovations were originally meant to establish Israel in Canaan, but his brothers' lack of vision resulted in that wisdom building Egypt instead.
Believers often trade their God-given gifts and innovative ideas to worldly systems for security and a paycheck rather than building kingdom territory.
Comfort turns believers into consumers rather than soldiers, leading God to allow pressure and discomfort so they will desire deliverance.
Trauma and a slave mindset make people demand visible signs before believing, whereas God seeks people who believe His word directly.
The Law of Agreement dictates that spiritual entities require human agreement to act, while the Law of Alignment shows there is no neutral ground in the spiritual realm.
True biblical agreement (*ya'ad*) is not human compromise (*symphoneo*), but an appointed time of deep, betrothal-like intimacy with God.
Great exploits come from *yada*—deeply knowing God and being willing to be fully known by Him without hiding behind shame.
Covenants require sacrifice and personal consecration; believers must clean their own altars and slay their own spiritual giants rather than relying on borrowed anointings.
qs: Satan can't do anything without man's agreement. God won't do anything without his agreement.
There is no demilitarized place in the spirit. No matter where you go, you have to contend for what you have.
You're not going to build a nation here in church. You're going to build a nation on your knees.
chk: SpaceX's Wall Street prospectus contains an $800+ billion bonus clause for Elon Musk if he colonizes Mars with one million people.
Jesus rose from the dead specifically on the 17th day of the month of Nisan.

t: Land Needs to Be Redeemed
s: Daniel Duval argues that believers are Melchizedek priests whose authority extends beyond personal ministry to redeeming physical land and elemental creation. He claims spiritual bondage often stems from ancestral land trades and occult covenants, which believers must dismantle through bloodline repentance.
r: Romans 8 · 1 Peter · John 14:12 · Daniel 11:32 · Matthew 14:22-32 · Matthew 8:23-27 · 1 Corinthians 2:9 · Daniel 12:4 · John 16:12-13 · Exodus 15:11-13 · Numbers 16 · Revelation 12:13-16 · Judges 5 · Isaiah 24 · Psalm 89:11 · Psalm 115:16 · Genesis 10 · Leviticus 18:24-28 · Genesis 18:25
pts: Salvation automatically drafts a believer into the Melchizedek priesthood under Jesus Christ, tasked with ministering to God, mankind, and creation.
According to Romans 8, creation itself is groaning in futility, waiting for the sons of God to exercise redemptive authority.
Fear and unbelief are the two primary obstacles preventing believers from walking in supernatural sonship and greater works.

Biblical precedent shows creation participating in God's judgments and deliverance, including the earth swallowing Pharaoh's army, the earth opening during Korah's rebellion, and Jesus calming weather.
God owns the earth as supreme judge, leasing its stewardship to humans; Satan operates through subleases gained by deceiving human authorities.
Land ownership models throughout history dictate spiritual authority over territories, meaning wicked rulers can bind land to demonic systems.
Starting spiritual initiatives on defiled land often fails because unaddressed territorial iniquity recycles back onto the people.
Occult practitioners exploit spiritual mechanics, using elemental manipulation and bloodline authority to tie people into demonic networks.
Deliverance often requires identifying internal subconscious trauma fragments and repenting for ancestral trade agreements made with cosmic and elemental entities.
qs: You can't have salvation without being recruited into the priesthood.
Fear and unbelief is the enemy of the supernatural.
The earth collaborated with Moses.
chk: Claims millions of trafficking victims are held in underground bases secured by free-energy and frequency weapons.
Claims to have personally witnessed physical limbs regrow and food multiply through ministry miracles.
Claims human bondages can be recorded on spiritual blockchain ledgers inside other people's inner subconscious systems.

t: Babylon wants Jerusalem
s: A prophetic framework identifying the ancient spiritual war between Babylon and Jerusalem over physical geography, calling believers to exercise Melchizedek authority to redeem the land and actively depower the Antichrist's agenda.
r: Hebrews 12:22 · Psalm 87:5-6 · Ezekiel 28:16 · Genesis 10:8-12 · Genesis 14:18 · Joshua 10:3 · Joshua 15:63 · 2 Thessalonians 2 · Daniel 11:28-31 · Daniel 11:32 · Daniel 11:36-37 · Daniel 11:40-45 · Matthew 24 · Mark 13:14-22 · Revelation 11 · Revelation 13:1-2 · Revelation 16 · Revelation 19 · John 14:12 · 1 Corinthians 2:9 · Zechariah 14
pts: Adam was created as a king-priest to minister first to God and to creation, establishing a land-stewardship mandate that Jesus fulfills and extends to the Church as a Melchizedek priesthood.
Moves of God are frequently cut short in geographic regions because ministries focus exclusively on evangelizing people while neglecting the spiritual defilement of the physical land.
Jerusalem and Babylon are both spiritual and physical realities; heavenly Jerusalem sits on Mount Zion as a cosmic template that physical geography and earthly altars are built to mirror.

Shortly after the Flood, Nimrod built Babel in the land of Shinar using pre-existing spiritual knowledge to manifest darkness, while Melchizedek ruled Salem (Jerusalem) according to the heavenly template.

Jerusalem is a primary geographic nexus of spiritual ley lines designed to interface heaven and earth, which is why the kingdom of darkness has perpetually sought to control it from the Jebusites to Nebuchadnezzar.
Current global conflicts and wars targeting the Middle East are intended by the kingdom of darkness to defile the land with bloodshed, creating spiritual alignment for the Antichrist's rule.
The Antichrist will seek physical and spiritual rulership from Jerusalem and a rebuilt third temple, but he will face constant armed and spiritual opposition rather than total automatic control.

The Antichrist receives his power, throne, and authority directly from Satan (the dragon), not from God, meaning the Church can actively subtract from his coming power by breaking covenants, dismantling demonic grids, and setting captives free in real time.
The promised 'greater works' of John 14:12 include an end-time manifestation where redeemed creation itself actively fights against demonic agendas alongside the mature sons of God.
qs: The battle between Babylon and Jerusalem is ancient.
The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.
We get to depower the coming Antichrist kingdom in real time.
chk: The claim that archaeologists discovered 'Temple Zero' in Jerusalem as the pre-Levitical site where Melchizedek served as priest.
The claim that the Hebrew grammar of Genesis 10:9 strictly designates Nimrod as a 'mighty hunter against God' with direct connection to Nephilim power.
The historical narrative regarding the Rothschild purchase of 50,000 hectares in the 1800s as a coordinated precursor to the 1948 establishment of Israel.
for: Believers seeking deeper understanding of spiritual warfare, eschatology, and how territorial land redemption relates to end-times biblical prophecy.

t: STOP Misunderstanding Tithing..It is NOT What You Think it is!
s: A theological framework redefining tithing not as an Old Testament legal burden or wealth-generating scheme, but as an ancient Melchizedek spiritual technology that sanctifies money, secures future generations, and protects believers from spiritual landmines in the marketplace.
r: Galatians 3:5-9 · Romans 4:15-16 · Luke 7:31-32 · Hebrews 7:1-11 · Genesis 13:1-2 · Ecclesiastes 10:19 · Genesis 14:17-23
pts: Scripture operates on two incompatible spiritual operating systems: the Law of Moses (focused on condemnation and works) and the order of Faith and Grace established with Abraham and fulfilled in Jesus.

Using Malachi 3 to enforce tithing under grace is an error, as Malachi belongs to the inferior Levitical operating system meant only for Old Covenant Israel, whereas New Testament believers operate under the superior Melchizedek order.

Jesus described people as 'children sitting in the marketplace' (Luke 7:31-32) because believers are spiritually naive to the demonic entrapments, secret societies, and spiritual forces active in daily commerce.

Tithing was never designed to generate money, because ungodly people frequently acquire wealth without God; rather, it was instituted to protect the believer from the spiritual hazards and destructive nature of unsanctified wealth.

God intentionally withheld the revelation of tithing until Abraham was already extremely wealthy (Genesis 13:2) and had experienced the familial strife, marital compromise, and moral grief resulting from unsanctified Egyptian riches.

Under Hebrews 7, tithes are not paid to human pastors or a collective institution ('them'), but directly to the resurrected Jesus ('a he... of whom it is witnessed that he lives'), creating a judicial testimony in the spirit realm.
Pastors and church leaders are only earthly proxies for Jesus Christ, meaning personal offenses against leaders should not stop a believer from honoring the high priest with the tithe.

Levi paid tithes while still in Abraham's loins as a spiritual 'licensing fee' to connect the earthly Levitical priesthood to the heavenly order, demonstrating that tithing can secure the spiritual callings of unborn generations.
Because Ecclesiastes 10:19 states that 'money answers everything,' money is spiritually responsive and absorbs the spiritual voices and occultic mantras spoken over it in the marketplace.
Under the law of firstfruits, dedicating the 10 percent tithe acts as a spiritual cleansing technology that silences malevolent voices and purifies the remaining 90 percent of the believer's income.
Melchizedek brought bread and wine to Abraham to demonstrate that communion is a marketplace weapon providing continuous spiritual fellowship, divine direction, and discernment during daily commerce.
The tithe functions spiritually like a password that logs a believer's finances into God's secure server, guarding them against spiritual malware, scams, and demonic manipulation.
qs: Any pastor who uses Malachi 3 to collect ties and offering does not understand tithing because Malachi was written for the law.
windows are for people living on the outside.
Tell them the tithe is the password to come on my secure server.
chk: He claims a former high-ranking African Buddhist monk told him that Buddhist priests place monthly 'money mantras' on cash change to intentionally siphon wealth away from Christians.
He asserts that God verbally told him his fivefold calling is that of an 'archaeologist' assigned to uncover ancient biblical foundations to redefine modern understanding.
He states that a high-profile Jamaican attorney committed suicide after being blackmailed by Freemasons demanding the sacrifice of his only son.
for: Believers, business owners, and marketplace professionals who struggle with traditional prosperity teachings on tithing or experience spiritual warfare in their finances.

t: Heaven's Agenda Unleashed
s: A theological framework asserting that believers in the order of Melchizedek are assigned to break spiritual territorial bondages and redeem physical creation back under God's government to prepare for Christ's return.
r: Genesis 9:1-3 · Psalm 24:1 · Psalm 115:16 · Luke 4:5-7 · Matthew 16:18 · Hebrews 6:19-20 · Colossians 1:19-20 · Mark 16:15 · Acts 3:20-21
pts: The church's mission field is not limited to human evangelism; it extends to governing in the second heaven and ministering redemption directly to the defiled physical earth.

The earth suffers from a spiritual equivalent of Stockholm syndrome, having been seeded with iniquity through rituals, bloodshed, and occult agreements to the point that creation cooperates with the enemy.
Human beings were created as king-priests in the order of Melchizedek, and territorial redemptive assignments fall under the legal authority of Christ's ecclesia.

During a 2013 ministry trip to Rwanda, the speaker claims he entered the spirit realm, engaged a territorial principality on a massive throne, and saw immediate natural breakthroughs—such as a gang being arrested and a poverty spirit breaking in a village—once the spiritual throne was dismantled.
Spiritual breakthrough in a territory requires a trustworthy local gatekeeper of solid character to sustain the open heaven, or the natural gains will be lost.

God originally leased the earth to mankind rather than Satan (Genesis 9:1-3; Psalm 115:16), meaning demonic powers have no legal right to rule creation except through human agreements, bloodline covenants, and evil rituals.
In Luke 4:5-7, Satan possessed the kingdoms of the world not by divine decree, but because generations of humans traded away their authority for counterfeit power and wealth.
Jesus established the church (ekklesia) as a governing council authorized to break down demonic gates and reclaim plundered domains across creation (Matthew 16:18; Colossians 1:19-20).
Mark 16:15 commands believers to preach the gospel to every creature (Greek: ktisis), which includes subjugating the elemental kingdom and physical nature back into divine order.

In deliverance ministry with ritual abuse survivors, the subconscious heart functions as a vast internal territory containing gates, portals, and demonic thrones that can be entered and cleared through spiritual engagement.

The 'restoration of all things' in Acts 3:20-21 implies that an end-time generation will bring a representative portion of creation back into theocratic alignment, triggering the Second Coming of Jesus Christ.
qs: the more iniquity the devil can get seated into the earth, the more effective the earth will be at hosting his agenda.
God did not lease the earth to Satan, to Satan's minions, to fallen angels. He leased it to man.
The gospel of the kingdom is the good news of God's government and it extends beyond convicting men to surrender their lives to Jesus.
the work of bringing redemption to creation doesn't begin at the return of Jesus Christ. It begins with the generation he sent to trigger it.
chk: The speaker's account of spiritually traveling through an internal portal in a ritual abuse survivor's heart to an 'antichrist planet' in another dimension to battle demonic armies.
The assertion that his spiritual confrontation in Rwanda directly triggered the arrest of a local gang and instant economic shifts in a village the following day.
The linguistic claim that 'ktisis' in Mark 16:15 commands preaching the gospel to non-human elements and nature.
for: Believers seeking advanced concepts in territorial spiritual warfare, creation deliverance, and the Melchizedek priesthood.

t: The Priesthood of the Night (SLEEP - The Door to the Realm of Dreams)
s: Francis Myles argues that God's highest gift to humanity is priesthood rather than salvation, functioning through spiritual altars where human beings surrender personal authority in exchange for divine power. He claims that sleep is a legal portal into a dream realm where God downloads wisdom and wealth, but where demonic forces also plant sickness, fears, and sabotage that believers must actively cast out.
r: Genesis 1:26-27 · Genesis 2:21 · Leviticus 6:12-13 · Psalms 8:3-4 · Psalm 62:11 · Genesis 15:12 · Matthew 13:24
pts: Salvation is a recovery program rather than the final destination; it exists to restore what humanity lost in the fall.
God's greatest gift to man is priesthood—the ability to minister directly to God and arrest divine judgment through intercession.
Angels were created to offer worship and praise, but God created humanity in His own image specifically to have sovereign, will-to-will fellowship.
To solve the issue of two sovereigns interacting without violating territorial dominion, God instituted altars as legal interfaces and embassies between heaven and earth.
The primary spiritual mechanism of an altar is trade: humans give God authority (surrendering personal control), and God provides power.
The altar fire must never go out (Leviticus 6:12-13); if the fire dies, the legal exchange and divine fellowship cease.
Sleep is not merely physical rest, but a portal into an intermediate realm where a person's waking, controlling will is bypassed.
While the body sleeps, the spirit remains active, enabling God to impart covenants, strategies, business concepts, and wisdom (as seen with Abraham and Solomon).
Because fallen angels retain access to the dream realm, demonic forces use sleep to sow seeds of division, poverty, fear, and infirmity.
Believers must exercise spiritual authority to uproot demonic dream impartations and command spiritual entities (symbolized as serpents) to leave.
qs: The number one duty is to exchange power for authority.
Man has access to a realm and the door to the realm is sleep.
chk: Claims that physical conditions such as cancer, arthritis, and uterine fibroids originate as spiritual implants from the dream world and cannot be cured by earthly medicine alone.
Claims he has supernaturally visited and ministered to people in other countries while his physical body was asleep in America.

t: 7 GATES YOU MUST MASTER BEFORE THE ECONOMY GATE OPENS || APOSTLE ISI IGENEGBA
s: To unlock lasting covenant wealth, believers must master foundational spiritual gates—including territorial altars, marital priesthood, mindset, relational integrity, spiritual trade, and sacrificial leadership—before economic gates will open.
r: Genesis 28 · Ezekiel 37 · Ephesians 3:20 · Ezekiel 28
pts: Economic dominance is not won through physical negotiations alone, but by prevailing over the spiritual altars and ruling deities governing territorial economies.
The strength of any throne or position of authority is directly determined by the strength of the altar backing it, the viability of the sacrifice, and the commission of the priest.
Jacob was able to outmaneuver Laban's divinations and generational traps because God anchored him to the altar of Bethel, a spiritual reality now personified in Jesus Christ.
Dreams indicate active spiritual altars in a territory; nocturnal attacks or sexual violations in dreams are attempts by spirits to open legal gates and activate curses.

Marriage represents an exchange of 'essence' (referencing the Hebrew word *etsem* for bone), meaning partnering with an ungodly spouse can corrupt covenant wealth just as Jezebel destroyed Israel's economy under Ahab.
Believers must spiritually vet prospective spouses by examining family lineages for patterns of premature death, insanity, or idolatrous altars before entering a marital covenant.
Possessing the gate of the mind requires training thought patterns to think territorially and royally according to God's will rather than merely entertaining passive aspirations.
The people gate requires maintaining relational integrity and avoiding the 'Absalom spirit,' which exploits borrowed influence and steals spiritual fatherhood for selfish ambition.
The trading gate reflects that spiritual transactions occur in the spirit realm, where Babylon trades in the souls of men using worldly desires as negotiation points.
Accessing the economy gate requires stepping through the leadership gate; Moses had to confront Egypt's gods and submit to personal purification before Israel could plunder Egypt's silver and gold.
qs: your throne is as strong as the altar backing it up.
The doors you open in the spirit is what provokes the doors of economy to fling open to you.
Money is for covenant. INFLUENCE IS FOR COVENANT. WEALTH IS FOR COVENANT.
chk: The claim that the original Hebrew text of Ezekiel 37:3 literally translates 'thou knowest' as the past-tense 'you knew'.
The claim that she was regularly sowing $5,000 offerings as a 19-year-old.
for: Believers aspiring to marketplace and economic dominion who need to understand the spiritual prerequisites, character tests, and covenant dynamics required to carry wealth.

t: BUILDING PROPHETIC ECONOMY || APOSTLE ISI IGENEGBA
s: A prophetic economy occurs when enterprise, government policy, and spiritual priesthood align under divine purpose rather than greed. Because trade involves spiritual authority and allegiance, sustainable prosperity requires consecrated work, ethical systems, and forward-looking stewardship.
r: Haggai 2:7-9 · Deuteronomy 8:17-18
pts: Economic trade is not merely an exchange of goods and services; it represents an exchange of spiritual authority and underlying values.
A nation's economy reflects its core allegiances, typically organized around God, gold, or greed.
A prophetic economy is defined as the harmonic integration of enterprise (innovation and trade), policy (governance and law), and priesthood (spiritual alignment and consecration).
When an economy is consecrated to righteous principles, prosperity serves a constructive purpose; when corrupted, wealth turns into a tool for oppression.
Heaven evaluates wealth based on its intended purpose and covenantal stewardship rather than the sheer volume of possessions.
Economic recovery and sustainable systems require renewing spiritual foundations and ethics before simply injecting capital.
Leaders must identify corrupted practices (such as greed in finance or exploitation in resource extraction) and establish forward-looking, ethical policies rather than purely reactive rules.
Business partnerships and trade agreements should be audited to avoid spiritually or financially parasitic alliances.
qs: Economy is not merely an exchange of goods and services. It is actually an exchange of spiritual authority.
Where economies are consecrated, prosperity becomes prophetic. Where economies are corrupted, wealth becomes weaponized.
Behind every marketplace there's an altar. Behind every currency there's a covenant.

t: This is exactly what happens every time you pray.
s: Explains how a believer functions as a spiritual altar and how prayer operates as priesthood to authorize God's intervention on earth.
pts: An altar is defined as a platform where the spiritual realm contacts the physical realm on legal grounds.
A human being functions as an altar through which God can touch lives, reach families, and bless nations.
Prayer is not just simple communication; it is an act of priesthood.
Praying is standing at an altar to legally authorize God's will over your life and children.
God will not force His way into personal situations, so prayer is required to grant Him permission to intervene.

Prayer is priesthood.
God will never force himself into my situations.

s: Explains how spiritual authority and power stem from consistently tending to your prayer altar as an act of priesthood.

pts: In 1 Kings 13, King Jeroboam was found personally attending to and servicing an altar at Bethel despite already holding national power.
The power of any altar depends on someone consistently servicing it.
You cannot neglect an altar and still expect to move in spiritual power.

what makes an altar relevant is when you are able to attend your altar regularly.

t: Day 16 - A Priest on His Throne Module-16
s: Under the Melchizedek priesthood, supernatural wealth transfer from the world system operates through God releasing 'crowns' (wealth-generating ideas) and 'thrones' (seats of opportunity at influential tables).
r: Zechariah 6:1-15 · Revelation 18:1-3 · Genesis 33
pts: Myles argues that while televangelists often preach a supernatural wealth transfer from the wicked to the righteous, the charismatic church has lacked a practical theological model to see it actually happen.

Examining Zechariah 6, Myles identifies the four chariots coming from between bronze mountains as high-ranking angelic forces sent directly from God's throne room to execute a major earthly assignment.
The 'north country' in Zechariah represents the kingdom and throne of God, which Myles claims cannot be at rest while God's people remain trapped in poverty and subservient to lenders.
Babylon, as referenced in Zechariah 6 and Revelation 18, is defined as the demonic world system that controls global governance, media, trade, and economic resources.

Zechariah is commanded to take gold and silver offerings from exiles out of Babylon to fashion crowns, placing one on Joshua the high priest to foreshadow the Messiah ('The Branch') ruling as a priest upon His throne.
The Levitical priesthood is described as one-dimensional because Levites could only serve as priests without crowns or thrones, creating an artificial divide between the temple and the marketplace.
The Order of Melchizedek unites the offices of king (marketplace governance) and priest (spiritual communion), bringing seamless alignment between ministry and enterprise.
Myles defines the prophetic 'crown' placed on the head as divine, wealth-generating ideas and intellectual property given by God that money naturally follows.
He defines the prophetic 'throne' as a God-given seat at the table of opportunity, where believers gain equity and wealth by stewarding influence, even when the original idea belongs to someone else.
Jacob is presented as an example of receiving a 'crown idea' via a dream to gain wealth through sheep breeding despite Laban's unfair labor contracts.
Joseph is presented as an example of receiving a 'throne' by being given a seat at Pharaoh's table, becoming wealthy through faithful administration without owning the empire.
qs: God is very interested in a theology of practice than just talking about stuff.
God is interested in the supernatural transfer of wealth because revival without wealth is shortlived.
Money follows ideas.
chk: The claim that Google purchased YouTube from two college boys who each walked away with approximately $300 million (YouTube was founded by three individuals and acquired for $1.65 billion in Google stock).
The assertion that placing peeled, striped branches before mating animals constitutes ancient genetic manipulation validated by modern genetics.
Myles's assertion that he received an accredited doctorate from an American university based specifically on being recognized as having the world's foremost revelation on Melchizedek.
for: Believers, leaders, and marketplace ministers seeking a practical biblical framework to break out of financial lack and engage business through king-priest authority.

t: Day 17 -  Breaking Generational Curses Under The Order of Melchizedek Module 17
s: Francis Myles teaches that generational curses operate through biological and spiritual DNA inherited from ancestors. He presents 'jumping the line' as a prophetic courtroom ritual to sever ancestral bloodlines and receive Christ's flawless genetic inheritance.
r: Hebrews 7:2-3 · Luke 19:9-10 · Genesis 1:26 · Genesis 5:1-3 · Ezekiel 16:1-6
pts: Generational curses are defined as curses attached to the specific ration of genes inherited from ancestral lineages.
Genetic salvation is defined as applying the finished work of the cross to heal broken DNA so demonic powers have no legal pathway of entry.
Adam and Eve originally possessed flawless genetics and the literal genetic likeness of God; after the fall, subsequent generations inherited fallen genetics.
Because Jesus operates under the Order of Melchizedek—being without earthly mother, father, or genealogy—His priesthood sits above natural parentage and can legally sever ancestral ties.
Iniquities in the bloodline produce a spiritual noise or frequency that summons corresponding demonic spirits against a person's destiny.
Superimposed DNA is introduced into a person's life through secondary entry points such as blood transfusions, witchcraft rituals, trauma, sexual assault, adoption, or mind control.
Traditional generational repentance is incomplete because a family lineage is longer than human memory; a complete legal cutoff is required instead.
Jumping the line is a physical prophetic act that enacts a covenant exchange: renouncing ancestral lineage and stepping into Christ's incorruptible bloodline.
High praise (tehillah) immediately following the prophetic jump enters God's courtroom protocol to finalize and enforce the legal deliverance.
qs: likeness is a genetic function.

t: Day 14 - The Seven Mountains Module-14
s: A spiritual framework explaining that cultural spheres are guarded by high-ranking fallen angels, requiring believers to invoke the authority of the Melchizedek priesthood rather than relying solely on personal charisma to survive the moral and economic hazards of the 'corruption zone.'

pts: Culture is organized into seven foundational mountains: Law and Government, Finance, Media/Arts/Entertainment, Education, Business, Family, and Church.
The mountain of Law and Government is the supreme regulatory mountain because it establishes the legal framework and constitutional boundaries governing all other six mountains.

The mountain of Finance controls global currencies, investments, and banking policies, requiring believers to speak directly to the spiritual mountain rather than merely negotiating with natural banks.

The mountain of Business serves as the primary employer in society and exists fundamentally to generate profit, which he argues is an essential biblical metric of stewardship based on the Parable of the Talents.

The cultural mountains are guarded by territorial fallen angels rather than entry-level demons, meaning marketplace leaders face systemic spiritual opposition as they gain influence.

When believers reach the corruption zone relying only on their personal gifting, they frequently experience catastrophic failures, including moral scandals, divorce, burnout, and financial ruin.
To overcome the corruption zone, believers must practice spiritual invocation—calling upon the legal order and priesthood of Melchizedek to fight on their behalf.

Just as David donned the high priest's linen ephod at Ziklag to inquire of God and recover all after total disaster, believers must step into priestly Melchizedek authority to overturn marketplace losses.

t: Day 12 The Fathering Dimension Module 12
s: A framework distinguishing the self-serving 'exalted father' and orphan spirit from the generational 'fathering spirit' of the Melchizedek order, illustrating how leaders can transition from personal performance to empowering future generations.
r: Malachi 4:5-6 · John 3:16 · Genesis 14 · Genesis 15 · Genesis 17 · Job 1:1 · Galatians 5:22-23 · Genesis 45:8
pts: Francis Myles introduces Module 12 of his 18-module school on the Order of Melchizedek, emphasizing that true leadership requires healing from father wounds and operating in a generational fathering dimension.

The speaker references Malachi 4:5-6 as a foundational prophetic text, arguing that turning the hearts of fathers to children and children to fathers is God's final strategy to prevent a curse upon the land.
The transition from 'Abram' (meaning exalted father) to 'Abraham' (father of many nations) represents a shift from self-absorbed leadership to generational thinking and caring for others' destinies.

The 'exalted father' mindset manifests in modern church and marketplace leadership whenever leaders demand that people serve their personal platform rather than empowering and investing in their spiritual children.
The fathering spirit is described as life-giving and not restricted by gender; both men and women (including single mothers) can carry and minister it because it originates from the Holy Spirit.
The orphan spirit is defined as the root cause of societal collapse, originating when Lucifer and fallen angels disconnected themselves from God's family, transitioning from sons to orphans.

Key symptoms of an orphan spirit include a compulsive drive to succeed for validation, eating disorders, self-obsession, hypersensitivity to offense, excessive control, sexual compulsion, depression, and fear of relational intimacy.
Spiritual government requires delivering confrontation without destructive emotional anger, maintaining authority in humility rather than operating out of offense or insecurity.
True spiritual fathers do not attempt to clone followers into duplicates of themselves; they celebrate distinct giftings and do not view rising leaders as competition.
Joseph operated under the Melchizedek order rather than the Levitical priesthood, holding spiritual preeminence in Egypt by serving as a father to Pharaoh according to Genesis 45:8.
Pharaohs and royal children were institutional orphans raised by servants and protocol, which positioned Joseph's fathering mantle to guide the ruler and manage Egypt's economy.

pts: Francis Myles claims God instructed him in Zambia to release his 18-module Melchizedek course for free on YouTube because foreign payment systems prevent international believers from purchasing it.
The speaker, Lee Roberson, defines 'manifest' as both appearing and actively demonstrating God's kingdom on earth.
Roberson asserts that Romans 8:19-22 says creation is waiting for the revealing of 'sons' (plural), not just Jesus or institutional church leaders, to break creation out of corruption.
God's original mandate in Genesis 1:26-28 was to make the earth a colony of heaven through fruitful multiplication, replenishment, and subdued dominion.

t: Day 9   An In depth Analysis of The Order of Melchizedek   Module 9
s: Dr. Francis Myles presents the Order of Melchizedek as Christ's eternal royal priesthood that replaces human dysfunction with divine order, righteousness, and peace. He argues that entering this priesthood unites marketplace leadership with priestly authority while uprooting internal patterns that addict people to chaos.
r: Psalm 110:1-4 · 2 Corinthians 5:17 · Hebrews 5 · Exodus 19 · Genesis 14
pts: Myles reports that Jesus visited him in Zambia and commanded him to release his 18-module Melchizedek school for free on YouTube so global believers could access it.

Second Corinthians 5 teaches that believers must no longer know Christ or one another after the flesh; Myles argues this perspective is necessary to end racial prejudice and build a church of all nations.
Psalm 110:4 records God making an unbreakable vow that the Messiah is a priest forever in the Order of Melchizedek.
Hebrews 5 indicates that deep truths about Melchizedek remain veiled to immature believers who survive on milk, because spiritual babies are too self-absorbed to handle heavyweight kingdom realities.
God wraps high-level revelations in mystery to protect them from unprepared people and to outmaneuver demonic powers.

God originally offered Israel the Melchizedek priesthood of kings and priests at Mount Sinai (Exodus 19), but because the people preferred natural limits, God instituted the lower Levitical priesthood.
King David bypassed Levitical rules by housing the Ark of the Covenant in a tent for 41 years and eating consecrated showbread because he operated in the higher Melchizedek priesthood.
The 41 years the Ark spent in David's tent mirrors the 41 generations from Adam to Christ, after which God's presence and humanity were permanently reconciled.
Drawing an analogy from physics, Myles states that all particles drift toward chaos unless intercepted by an organizing force; the Order of Melchizedek acts as that force in a believer's life.
The Melchizedek order combines marketplace authority (kings) with spiritual devotion (priests) and rests on Christ's righteousness rather than human works.
True shalom means not only completeness, but also deliverance from the internal principle that addicts a person to relational, personal, or financial chaos.
External financial aid and hyped 'miracle money' fail to solve poverty if individuals and leaders remain mentally addicted to chaotic habits.

t: Day 7 - The King of Sodom | Module 7
s: A framework identifying the 'Sodomic system' of generational moral decay and how operating under the priesthood of Melchizedek provides the authority and moral backbone to reject compromise and say 'not on my watch.'
r: Acts 2:40 · Galatians 5:19 · Genesis 12:12-13
pts: Perversity is defined not merely as sexual deviation, but as turning away from what is right or good, as well as obstinately opposing what is right.
The principle of perversity functions as a systemic engine embedded within all man-made institutions, including politics, education, and religion.

The Sodomic system operates generationally, compounding moral degradation over time, as illustrated by the progression from Abraham's righteousness to Lot moving to Sodom, to Lot's daughters engaging in incest.
According to Acts 2:40, there is a distinct dimension of salvation where understanding the order of Melchizedek delivers believers from the prevailing perversity of their generation.
The King of Sodom represents five core traits: ultra-liberalism without restraint, rampant sexual perversion, mismanagement of seed, disruption of family, and the spirit of the antichrist.

Mismanagement of seed includes the destruction of human life through abortion as well as squandering financial resources on personal glorification rather than caring for orphans and advancing God's kingdom.
The primary indicator that one has yielded to the Sodomic mindset is compromise, often revealed when a person excuses known wrongdoing with rationalizations starting with 'but.'
While religious passivity responds to societal evil with mere sorrow, believers operating in Melchizedek authority exercise governmental spiritual authority to actively stand against wickedness.

The speaker illustrates overcoming the Sodomic system in the marketplace by recounting how she returned a competitor's textbook that had been obtained through dishonest means, which subsequently led to an uncompromised promotion.

When you compromise, you are entering into sodomic territory.
